35832.title: Global Temperature and Global Mortality
35832.zh_title: 全球气温与全球死亡率
35832.authors: Adrien Bilal, Diego R. Känzig, Krzysztof Lisiecki
35832.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文记录了气候变化带来的巨大间接死亡率影响。利用全球气温的自然变异性，我们发现气温升高1°C会使年死亡率增加每1,000人2.5例死亡，而与之相关的局部高温暴露仅导致每1,000人0.1例死亡。利用全球收入对死亡率影响的外部估计，我们表明全球气温变化的宏观经济效应解释了这些估计之间差距的三分之二。我们利用这一证据在新古典增长模型中估计损害函数，该模型将死亡率与经济活动联系起来，并考虑了对死亡率影响的适应。
35832.abstract: This paper documents large indirect mortality impacts of climate change. Exploiting natural global temperature variability, we find that 1°C of warming increases annual mortality by 2.5 deaths per 1,000 individuals, compared to 0.1 deaths per 1,000 due to the associated local heat exposure. Using external estimates of the impact of global income on mortality, we show that the macroeconomic effects of global temperature changes explain two thirds of the gap between these estimates. We use this evidence to estimate damage functions in a neoclassical growth model that links mortality and economic activity and accounts for adaptation to mortality impacts. Mortality contributes $400 per ton of CO₂ to the Social Cost of Carbon, or one quarter of total climate damages. These results suggest that economic adaptation has a double dividend by also reducing climate-related mortality.

35831.title: Subjective Models of the Macroeconomy and the Transmission of Monetary Policy
35831.zh_title: 宏观经济的主观模型与货币政策传导
35831.authors: Francesco D’Acunto, Dimitris Georgarakos, Geoff Kenny, Michael Weber
35831.zh_abstract_excerpt: 标准宏观经济理论假设代表性或异质性主体共享一个关于经济如何运行的共同模型。然而证据表明，家庭持有异质性的主观模型——即关于宏观经济变量如何相互作用的不同信念。因此，相同的冲击或政策可能引发原本相似家庭的不同反应。我们通过在一项大规模、多国调查中嵌入随机对照实验来测量主观模型，并考察其在货币政策向消费传导中的作用，以检验这一假设。认为货币紧缩主要通过借贷或储蓄利率效应发挥作用的消费者，在随机分配的利率上升情景下计划更多地减少消费。
35831.abstract: Standard macroeconomic theories assume that representative or heterogeneous agents share a common model of how the economy operates. Yet evidence shows that households hold heterogeneous subjective models---distinct beliefs about how macroeconomic variables interact. As a result, identical shocks or policies may elicit different responses from otherwise similar households. We test this hypothesis by measuring subjective models and investigating their role in the transmission of monetary policy to consumption embedding randomized controlled experiment in a large-scale, multi-country survey. Consumers who believe that monetary tightening primarily operates through its effects on borrowing or savings rates plan to reduce consumption more in response to randomly assigned rate increase scenarios. By contrast, those who think about inflation or general equilibrium effects adjust consumption less. These differences are not explained by demographics, financial characteristics, including mortgage holdings and mortgage type, or country-level factors. Households' actual consumption responses to endogenous policy-rate changes exhibit broadly similar patterns. Our findings stress that heterogeneity in subjective models is an overlooked determinant of monetary policy transmission.
35831.zh_abstract: 标准宏观经济理论假设代表性或异质性主体共享一个关于经济如何运行的共同模型。然而证据表明，家庭持有异质性的主观模型——即关于宏观经济变量如何相互作用的不同信念。因此，相同的冲击或政策可能引发原本相似家庭的不同反应。我们通过在一项大规模、多国调查中嵌入随机对照实验来测量主观模型，并考察其在货币政策向消费传导中的作用，以检验这一假设。认为货币紧缩主要通过借贷或储蓄利率效应发挥作用的消费者，在随机分配的利率上升情景下计划更多地减少消费。相比之下，那些考虑通胀或一般均衡效应的人对消费的调整较少。这些差异无法由人口统计特征、金融特征（包括抵押贷款持有情况和抵押贷款类型）或国家层面因素解释。家庭对内生政策利率变化的实际消费反应也表现出大体相似的模式。我们的发现强调，主观模型的异质性是货币政策传导中被忽视的决定因素。

35830.title: Economics of Demand-Side and Supply-Side Climate Policies
35830.zh_title: 需求侧与供给侧气候政策的经济学
35830.zh_abstract_excerpt: 一个寻求削减温室气体排放的司法管辖区应当使用针对化石燃料消费的需求侧气候政策吗？还是应当引入针对开采的供给侧政策？我的分析指向一种政策组合，而非非此即彼的选择。排放向未受监管司法管辖区的“泄漏”可以通过将标准的需求侧碳排放定价与供给侧的碳开采定价相结合来缓解。排放定价通过降低国外化石燃料价格来驱动泄漏；开采定价则抵消这一效应。然而，实践中的供给侧气候政策并不广泛地对开采定价，而是狭隘地阻止对化石燃料基础设施的投资，因此效率低下。
35830.abstract: Should a jurisdiction seeking to cut greenhouse gas emissions use demand-side climate policies that target fossil fuel consumption? Or should it introduce supply-side policies that target extraction? My analysis points to a policy portfolio rather than an either/or choice. ``Leakage'' of emissions to unregulated jurisdictions can be mitigated by combining standard demand-side carbon emissions pricing with supply-side pricing of carbon extraction. Emissions pricing drives leakage by lowering fossil fuel prices abroad; extraction pricing counteracts this effect. Supply-side climate policies in practice, however, do not broadly price extraction but instead narrowly foreclose investments in fossil fuel infrastructure and are thus inefficient. To reduce carbon demand, an alternative to emissions pricing is support for clean energy. I emphasize reforms to transmission planning and utility governance as crucial for unlocking clean energy resources' potential, and I highlight the case for publicly supporting clean energy R&D, including green industrial policy, to reduce carbon emissions not just at home but also abroad. I close by discussing distributional consequences. Domestically, carbon pricing and clean energy subsidies have sharply different distributional profiles. Globally, carbon extraction pricing would harm low-income countries that are also fossil fuel importers, though there also exist low-income fossil fuel exporters that would benefit.

35829.title: Importers, Market Power and Optimal Tariffs
35829.zh_title: 进口商、市场势力与最优关税
35829.authors: Jonathan Becker, Corina Boar, Virgiliu Midrigan
35829.zh_abstract_excerpt: 进口商数量少且规模大，具有更高的劳动生产率，并且将成本变化不完全地传导至价格。我们在一个与这些事实一致的模型中研究最优关税。企业支付固定成本以进口，并收取随规模增加的加成。市场势力意味着相对于有效配置，进口商数量过少且规模过小。关税放大了这一扭曲。我们推导出一个公式，将最优关税不仅与外国出口供给弹性联系起来，还与扭曲在多大程度上放大贸易成本对福利的影响联系起来。在我们的校准经济中，最优关税为负，并随国家规模增大而下降。
35829.abstract: Importers are few and large, have higher labor productivity and pass through cost changes to prices incompletely. We study optimal tariffs in a model consistent with these facts. Firms pay a fixed cost to import and charge markups that increase with size. Market power implies that importers are too few and too small relative to the efficient allocations. Tariffs amplify this distortion. We derive a formula that relates the optimal tariff not only to the foreign export supply elasticity but also to how much distortions amplify the effect of trade costs on welfare. In our calibrated economy the optimal tariff is negative and decreases with country size.

35828.title: Liability and Pricing of Dual-Use AI
35828.zh_abstract_excerpt: 当AI服务既能促成攻击又能促成防御时，AI提供者应承担多少责任？责任可以改善福利，同时增加伤害。提供者向生产性用户、攻击者和防御者出售一种共同投入。在一个有防御的争夺中，较高的共同价格会减少努力，而不改变攻击成功率或攻击者利润，从而节省资源并改善目标的安全收益。补偿会削弱防御并提高攻击者利润。最优责任在这些效应与生产性排斥之间进行权衡。更大的竞争可能降低最优责任；每一次这样的下降都必须终止于一个保留防御的结果。
35828.abstract: How much liability should AI providers bear when their services enable both attack and defence? Liability can improve welfare while increasing harm. Providers sell a common input to productive users, attackers and defenders. Within a defended contest, a higher common price reduces effort without changing attack success or attacker profits, saving resources and improving the target's security payoff. Compensation weakens defence and raises attacker profits. Optimal liability balances these effects against productive exclusion. Greater competition can lower optimal liability; every such decline must end at an outcome retaining defence. With cybersecurity access fixed, monopoly can warrant partial liability but never full liability when provision is worthwhile. When guardrails preserving productive uses are available, strong competition favours universal guarding socially but encourages unilateral removal at insufficient liability. At a fixed provider count, sufficiently many productive users ensure a pure equilibrium with universal guarding under high liability. A universal-guarding requirement makes liability redundant. Under monopoly, adoption follows a unique liability threshold, while zero liability remains uniquely optimal for a range of parameters with sufficiently many productive users.

35827.title: Crime in Covid Times
35827.zh_abstract_excerpt: 是什么导致了自2019年以来美国凶杀案历史上独特的波动，且主要由枪支凶杀案驱动？虽然候选解释并不缺乏，但由于人们普遍认为枪支暴力与其他犯罪一样，源于如Becker（1968）所述的理性权衡收益与成本，因此一直难以形成连贯的理解。该模型在解释近期凶杀趋势方面总体表现不佳。行为经济学有助于解释Becker模型无法解释的内容。这一观点始于一个事实：大多数枪击事件并不服务于某种更大的目标，如抢劫或为毒品地盘而进行的帮派战争（“工具性暴力”）；
35827.abstract: What caused the historically unique volatility in American homicides since 2019, driven by gun homicides? While there is no shortage of candidate explanations, a coherent understanding has been elusive because of the widely held view that gun violence, like other crimes, stems from a rational weighing of benefits and costs as in Becker (1968). This model does a generally poor job of explaining recent trends in homicide. Behavioral economics helps explain what the Becker model cannot. This view starts with the fact that most shootings don’t further some larger goal like robbery or gang wars over drug turf (“instrumental violence”); they’re arguments settled with guns (“expressive violence”). Why do arguments start or escalate? The behavioral model points to automatic cognition that is fast, effortless but sometimes prone to error. The pandemic increased automaticity by increasing distress – a cognitive “bandwidth tax.” Recent homicide trends, driven by changes in expressive violence, are mirrored by similar trends for deaths from drug overdose, car crashes, and suicide (especially for Black Americans, the group most affected by violence) – “deaths of decision-making.” Also relevant is a large rise and fall in gun carrying, which might partially stem from Becker-like mechanisms: Large changes in handgun sales and police stops, both of which may also have been affected by the killing of George Floyd. Since American gun violence is mostly arguments with guns, no wonder homicide trends are due mostly to changes in the number of arguments and the odds a given argument had a gun present.

35826.title: Accounting for Cross-Country Income Differences Revisited
35826.zh_title: 重新审视跨国收入差异的核算
35826.zh_abstract_excerpt: 发展核算是寻找跨国收入差异的直接来源。本文描述了自Caselli（2005）具有影响力的研究以来，该领域知识在过去二十年中的演变。在生产投入（劳动、物质资本和人力资本）的测度方面取得了巨大进展。这些进展提高了投入（主要是人力资本）在发展核算中的估计贡献。我们偏好的估计是，投入解释了每工人GDP差异的50--65%，而使用经典设定则为30%。
35826.abstract: Development accounting is the search for proximate sources of cross-country income differences. This article describes how knowledge in this field has evolved over the two decades since the influential work of Caselli (2005). There have been large advances in the measurement of production inputs (labor, physical capital, and human capital). These advances have raised the estimated contribution of inputs, mostly human capital, in development accounting. Our preferred estimate is that inputs account for 50--65 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) per worker differences, versus 30 percent using the classic specification. The literature has also made progress in moving away from Cobb-Douglas production functions and measuring factors such as management quality that were previously bundled into total factor productivity (TFP). Our review highlights the new implications of these advances, areas where future research would be beneficial, and the limitations of development accounting.

35825.title: The Positive Spillovers to Risky Investments in Vacant, Abandoned, and Disinvested Properties
35825.zh_title: 对空置、废弃和被撤资房产进行风险投资的正向溢出效应
35825.authors: Edward W. Chen, Reagan L. Lengefeld, Omar Isaac Asensio
35825.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本研究考察了佐治亚州萨凡纳市一项住房项目，该项目在先前空置、废弃或被撤资的房产上创建了可负担的填充式开发项目。萨凡纳是以萨凡纳港为依托的主要经济中心，许多城市社区仍受到撤资和气候风险的影响。本研究利用二十年记录关联的房产和税收数据，量化了这一公共干预带来的本地经济溢出效应，揭示了填充式住房政策此前隐藏的社会和经济收益。
35825.abstract: This study examines a housing program that created affordable infill developments on formerly vacant, abandoned, or disinvested properties in Savannah, Georgia. Savannah is a major economic hub anchored by the Port of Savannah, where many urban neighborhoods remain impacted by disinvestment and climate risk. Using two decades of record-linked property and tax data, this study quantifies local economic spillovers from this public intervention, revealing previously hidden social and economic benefits of infill housing policies. These benefits include an 11% increase in the market value of properties immediately neighboring an infill development site and an increase of up to 35% in areas with a high density of infill activity, pointing to block-level revitalization in climate-disadvantaged and distressed areas.

35824.title: Does Fertility Stabilize At Low Levels? Evidence from Period, Cohort, and Subnational Data

35824.zh_abstract_excerpt: 国际和政府机构使用的许多人口预测假设，在当今低生育率社会中，未来生育率将停止下降并大致稳定。本文评估了关于低水平均衡点或反弹的证据。我们表明，没有稳健证据支持系统性生育率反弹，也没有证据支持在任何通常假设的生育率水平上存在稳定均衡点。相反，在生育率降至低水平的地方和时期，它往往继续下降。这一点在一系列数据来源、时间段和生育率指标中都成立：联合国关于1950年至2023年所有国家-年份的时期总和生育率数据；

35822.authors: Gordon Y. Liao, Eswar S. Prasad, Tony Zhang
35822.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们表明，美元在全球金融的大多数方面仍然占主导地位。欧元和人民币在日益碎片化的第二层级货币中竞争，未能对美元形成明确挑战。我们研究金融创新可能如何重塑国际货币体系。原则上，创新会拉平国家之间的竞争环境，例如通过减少其他货币对之间交易中介对载体货币的需求，以及使获取和交易外国资产更容易。我们表明，另一种结果更有可能出现。
35822.abstract: We show that the dollar remains dominant in most aspects of global finance. The euro and renminbi are competing in an increasingly fragmented second tier of currencies, leaving no clear rivals to the dollar. We study how financial innovation could reshape the international monetary system. In principle, innovation levels the playing field between countries, for instance by reducing the need for vehicle currencies to intermediate transactions between other currency pairs and by making it easier to acquire and trade foreign assets. We show that an alternative outcome is more likely. Innovations that reduce frictions in cross-border transactions, especially dollar-backed payment stablecoins and other forms of tokenization of money, could interact with relative market thickness to reinforce the dollar’s dominance. This outcome is not preordained but depends on other countries’ willingness to embrace innovations and strengthen their financial markets and regulatory frameworks. While unipolarity has many disadvantages, we show that in some circumstances multipolarity might result in greater global fragility at times of financial market stress.

35821.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究内生刚性如何阻碍物质资本再配置。我们关注合同期限的作用——这是调整刚性的一个经典例子。我们认为，当代理人在市场稀薄的繁荣期签订更长期合同时，他们会产生一种合同外部性，这进一步放大稀薄性并阻碍市场对冲击的调整。我们构建了一个包含繁荣与萧条、代理人在其中搜寻并选择匹配期限的动态空间框架。将该框架应用于集装箱船租赁市场，我们发现内生刚性造成了显著错配，尤其是在崩溃后的过渡期。

35820.title: Social Sorting and Political Cleavages: Evidence from 2.5 Million Electoral Candidates

35820.zh_abstract_excerpt: 相互竞争政党的候选人池在社会层面有多大差异？由于姓名编码了标准社会经济变量所遗漏的文化环境、血统、语言来源和祖先信息，我们使用姓名来衡量政党间的社会分选，并在市镇-年份内进行样本外预测以判断党派归属。在超过250万名地方选举候选人中，姓名在西班牙随机抽取的同一市镇配对中能以55.8\%的概率正确识别右翼候选人，在法国为56.5\%。仅凭名字就完成了大部分工作：约为55.0\%。
35820.abstract: How socially distinct are competing political parties' candidate pools? Since names encode cultural milieu, lineage, linguistic origin, and ancestry that standard socioeconomic variables miss, we measure social sorting across parties with names, predicting affiliation out of sample within municipality-years. Across more than 2.5 million local-election candidates, names pick the right-wing candidate in a random within-municipality pair 55.8\% of the time in Spain and 56.5\% in France. Given names alone do most of the work: around 55.0%. Under a stylized model of intergenerational transmission of political orientation, this translates to an implied gap of about 25 p.p. in parental naming propensities. The signal is stable in Spain but doubles in France by 2026. Within ideological families, names separate parties as sharply as across the right--left divide, even more so in France. The Spanish cleavage is linguistic and growing. The French one runs through names of immigrant origin and is strongest in large cities.

35819.title: Timing, Trading Frictions, and the Limits of Subsidy Capture in Livestock Risk Protection
35819.zh_title: 时机、交易摩擦与牲畜风险保护中的补贴捕获限度
35819.authors: Yifei Zhang, Andrew Keller, Shawn Arita, Sandro Steinbach
35819.zh_abstract_excerpt: 当受保产品与私人交易的金融工具高度相似时，公共补贴保险项目可能产生补贴捕获激励。牲畜风险保护（LRP）就是这样一个案例，因为它通过一种与交易所交易看跌期权高度相似的合约提供价格保险。使用2020—2025年的LRP背书记录和匹配的CME期权数据，我们记录了背书活动集中在CME期权到期日附近，尤其是育肥牛和瘦肉猪。然而，由于生产者层面的衍生品头寸不可观测，仅凭时机模式无法识别补贴捕获。
35819.abstract: Publicly subsidized insurance programs can create incentives for subsidy capture when insured products closely resemble privately traded financial instruments. Livestock Risk Protection (LRP) is one such case because it provides price insurance through a contract that closely resembles an exchange-traded put option. Using LRP endorsement records and matched CME options data for 2020–2025, we document that endorsement activity clusters around CME option expiration dates, especially for feeder cattle and lean hogs. Because producer-level derivatives positions are unobserved, however, timing patterns alone cannot identify subsidy capture. We therefore simulate returns to combined LRP-CME strategies using observed contract terms, option prices, and trading frictions, including bid-ask spreads, margin requirements, and financing costs. We find that the subsidy-created premium wedge is observable at purchase, but realized gains are small, commodity-specific, and concentrated in low-volatility environments where realized volatility falls below implied volatility. Even in those favorable cases, combined strategies substantially worsen downside outcomes relative to holding LRP alone. Additional evidence shows that clustering persists across volatility regimes and after the 2025 revisions to the LRP Handbook, suggesting that observed timing patterns may reflect contract alignment and routine hedging practices, instead of widespread economically meaningful subsidy capture.

35818.authors: Orazio Attanasio, Raquel Bernal, Michele Giannola, Milagros Nores
35818.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文使用一项幼儿教育项目评估期间收集的儿童发展数据，估计了一个从1岁到6岁的人类发展动态模型。我们对三个潜在因子——健康、认知技能和社会情感技能——进行建模，并允许它们彼此互动，并与多种投入互动，以塑造后续发展。数据的高度丰富性和高频性质允许采用灵活设定，从而（i）允许复杂动态，（ii）让每个因子对其他因子的生产作出贡献，（iii）允许随年龄变化的生产技术，并且（iv）将父母投资视为内生。
35818.abstract: Using child development data collected during the evaluation of an early childhood education program, this paper estimates a dynamic model of human development from ages 1 to 6. We model three latent factors—health, cognitive skills, and socio-emotional skills—and allow them to interact with each other and with multiple inputs to shape subsequent development. The richness and high-frequency nature of the data permit a flexible specification that (i) allows for complex dynamics, (ii) lets each factor con- tribute to the production of the others, (iii) permits age-varying production technologies, and (iv) treats parental investment as endogenous. We use the estimated model to identify “windows of opportunity” in which parental interventions, or programs that increase investment, are especially effective. Results indicate that developmental dynamics are richer than typically assumed, with important implications for persistence: the impact of inputs can decay or endure in ways that vary across domains and over age. Accounting for endogenous investment is consequential for inference.

35816.title: The Great Accretion and the Great Depression
35816.authors: Harold L. Cole, Stefano Cravero, Jeremy Greenwood
35816.zh_abstract_excerpt: 第二次工业革命引发了一波新产品和新工业流程，推动了乐观的咆哮二十年代。但是，尽管20世纪20年代新产品开发放缓且需求已饱和，对技术进步的兴奋是否仍促成了投资的过度积累？而且，这种过度投资是否因持续的流程创新而加剧？这些因素是否可能在触发大萧条中发挥了作用？为探讨这些问题，本文提出了一个同时纳入流程创新和产品创新的宏观经济模型。我们进行了概念验证模拟，以评估这些因素是否有助于解释大萧条。答案是肯定的。
35816.abstract: The Second Industrial Revolution sparked a wave of new products and industrial processes, fueling an optimistic Roaring Twenties. But did excitement about technological progress contribute to an over accumulation of investment, despite a slowdown in new product development and satiated demand during the 1920s? And, was this over investment worsened by continuous process innovation? Could these factors have played a role in triggering the Great Depression? To explore these questions, a macroeconomic model that incorporates both process and product innovation is proposed. Proof-of-concept simulations are performed to assess whether these factors can help explain the Great Depression. The answer is yes.

35815.title: The Commoditization of Labor
35815.authors: Masao Fukui, Emi Nakamura, Jón Steinsson
35815.zh_abstract_excerpt: 技术变革往往简化工作。这提高了生产率，但也使工人更可替代——或者说更加“商品化”。劳动的商品化压低了工人的议价能力：任何人都能做这份工作，意味着工人是可抛弃的，这改善了企业的外部选择，并可能降低工人工资。我们建立了一个模型，捕捉商品化技术变革既提高生产率又压低工资的双重效应。商品化技术变革涉及企业将任务标准化。这降低了产出对工人质量的敏感性。企业受益，因为它们更容易为其持久性岗位填补空缺。
35815.abstract: Technical change often simplifies jobs. This increases productivity, but it also makes workers more substitutable–or more "commoditized." Commoditization of labor drives down worker bargaining power: anyone can do the job, implying workers are disposable, which improves the outside option of firms and can lower worker wages. We develop a model that captures both the productivity enhancing and wage depressing effects of commoditizing technical change. Commoditizing technical change involves firms standardizing tasks. This reduces the sensitivity of output to worker quality. Firms benefit because they can more easily fill vacancies for their durable jobs. We show that our model can help explain the divergence between productivity and wages in the service sector, increasing wage markdowns despite falling local concentration, and the decline of the large-firm wage premium.

35814.title: Foreign Opportunity and Regional Revival: Evidence from the French Rust Belt
35814.zh_title: 外部机遇与区域复兴：来自法国“锈带”的证据
35814.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文研究陷入困境的地区能否以及如何从产业衰退中复苏。我们利用法国“锈带”邻近居民进入日益繁荣的卢森堡劳动力市场的机会差异。我们记录了受处理的地方劳动力市场经历的三阶段扩张：最初是本地原有居民向跨境工作机会的就业替代，中期是本地劳动力利用率的上升，长期则是通过国内净迁入实现人口的持续增长。随后是更广泛的本地复兴进程，表现为收入提高、对转移支付依赖减少以及对社会失序的韧性，尽管这在一定程度上被住房成本上升和不均衡的拥堵所抵消。
35814.abstract: This paper studies whether and how distressed regions can recover from industrial decline. We exploit differences in access to an increasingly thriving Luxembourg labor market for neighboring residents of the French “Rust Belt.” We document a three-phase expansion of treated local labor markets, driven by an initial workplace substitution of incumbent residents towards cross-border job opportunities, a medium-term rise in local labor force utilization, and a long-run sustained increase in population via net domestic in-migration. A broader process of local revitalization follows, with higher incomes, reduced reliance on transfers, and resilience to social dislocation, although it is partially offset by rising housing costs and unequal congestion. This leads to a net decrease in far-right and anti- EU vote shares, muting the rise of populism visible elsewhere in former industrial regions of France. Our findings suggest that former industrial regions are not inherently rigid nor doomed to fall to anti-globalization backlash, but can and do adjust – given sufficiently large-scale reversals in local labor demand.

35813.title: The Dynamics of Development in a Zero-Sum World
35813.zh_title: 零和世界中的发展动态
35813.authors: Augustin Bergeron, Jean-Paul Carvalho, Joseph Henrich, Nathan Nunn, Jonathan L. Weigel
35813.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本章考察零和环境对文化变迁、创新和长期经济增长的后果。我们将创新引入Bergeron等人（即将发表）开发的框架，在该框架中，零和环境会催生去激励性信念。尽管去激励性信念通过限制零和环境中的过度竞争提高了静态效率，但我们表明，它们也可能阻碍长期增长。由于去激励性信念抑制努力，它们也可能减少干中学以及其他生产溢出。因此，它们可能抑制创新，并充当一种文化演化的拼凑物。我们应用该模型来解释1500年后西欧经济崛起相关的文化变迁。
35813.abstract: This chapter examines the consequences of zero-sum environments for cultural change, innovation, and long-term economic growth. We introduce innovation into the framework developed by Bergeron et al. (forthcoming), in which zero-sum environments give rise to demotivating beliefs. Although demotivating beliefs improve static efficiency by limiting excessive competition in zero-sum environments, we show that they can also impede long-term growth. Because demotivating beliefs suppress effort, they can also reduce learning-by-doing and other production spillovers. Hence, they can inhibit innovation and act as a cultural evolutionary kludge. We apply the model to explain the cultural changes associated with Western Europe's economic rise after 1500.

35812.title: Transportation Bottlenecks and Aggregate Shocks
35812.authors: Giulia Brancaccio, Myrto Kalouptsidi, Theodore Papageorgiou, Yixin Zhou
35812.zh_abstract_excerpt: 运输中断会影响总体结果吗？我们开发了一个易于处理的运输部门模型，以研究其对价格和国际贸易的影响。通过将海上运输建模为排队网络，该模型识别出运输瓶颈所在，并给出一个简单且易于计算的运输能力随时间变化的度量。我们使用航运和贸易数据校准该模型，并用它评估过去20年航运部门的韧性。在大供应链中断期间，港口瓶颈推高了商品价格并造成短缺，但同期商品供给收缩降低了航运需求，从而抑制了这些影响。
35812.abstract: Do transportation disruptions affect aggregate outcomes? We develop a tractable model of the transportation sector to study its impact on prices and international trade. By casting maritime transportation as a queueing network, the model identifies where the transportation bottlenecks lie and delivers a simple and easy-to compute measure of transportation capacity over time. We calibrate the model using shipping and trade data and use it to evaluate the resilience of the shipping sector during the last 20 years. During the Great Supply Chain Disruption, port bottlenecks raised commodity prices and caused shortages, but a contemporaneous contraction in commodity supply reduced shipping demand and thereby dampened these effects. By contrast, insufficient shipping capacity was a key driver of price increases during the 2000s Commodity Supercycle.

35811.title: Evaluating the Spatial Consequences of a Climate Tipping Point
35811.zh_title: 评估气候临界点的空间后果
35811.authors: José-Luis Cruz, Klaus Desmet, Esteban Rossi-Hansberg
35811.zh_abstract_excerpt: 大西洋经向翻转环流（AMOC）是一个洋流系统，在调节全球气候方面发挥关键作用，包括缓和欧洲和北大西洋的温度。其因全球变暖而可能崩溃被广泛认为是较可能发生的气候临界点之一。本文使用世界经济动态空间综合评估模型（S-IAM）考察这种崩溃的经济影响。预计斯堪的纳维亚和俄罗斯部分地区将遭受GDP和福利的显著损失，而南欧、北非和巴西则因温度略低而受益。
35811.abstract: The Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) is a system of ocean currents that plays a key role in regulating global climate, including moderating temperatures in Europe and the North Atlantic. Its potential collapse due to global warming is widely considered one of the more likely climate tipping points. This paper examines the economic implications of such a collapse using a dynamic spatially integrated assessment model (S-IAM) of the world economy. Scandinavia and parts of Russia are predicted to experience significant losses in GDP and welfare, while southern Europe, northern Africa, and Brazil benefit from slightly colder temperatures. S-IAMs generally predict that global warming is especially harmful to low-income regions, but an AMOC collapse could mitigate some of these negative impacts in parts of the developing world while instead harming some of the more advanced economies. This lowers spatial inequality, but global welfare drops by 1.9% by 2200 under an intermediate-emissions scenario.

35810.title: Like a Good Neighbor: Childhood Neighbors Influence Occupation Choice
35810.zh_title: 如好邻居：童年邻居影响职业选择
35810.authors: Michael J. Andrews, Ryan R. Hill, Joseph Price, Riley Wilson
35810.zh_abstract_excerpt: 职业选择是经济流动性的关键决定因素。本文研究童年邻居如何影响职业选择和晚年收入。我们使用超过600万名男孩和400万名女孩的关联历史美国人口普查记录，重建社区微观地理，以识别童年邻居及其职业。我们发现，与同一条街上的其他孩子相比，住在从事某一职业的人隔壁，会使30年后从事同一职业的概率提高约10%。当接触强度更高、社区联系更紧密以及邻里家庭更相似时，这种传递效应更强。
35810.abstract: Occupation choice is a key determinant of economic mobility. This paper studies how childhood neighbors influence occupational choices and later-life earnings. Using linked historical U.S. census records for over six million boys and four million girls, we reconstruct neighborhood microgeography to identify childhood neighbors and their occupations. We find that living next door to someone in a given occupation increases the probability of working in that same occupation 30 years later by about 10 percent relative to other children on the same street. The transmission effect is higher with more intense exposure, in more connected neighborhoods, and when neighboring families are more similar. Exposure to high-income or highly educated neighbors has lasting economic effects, leading to significant gains in adult income and education even compared to other children from the same street. These findings suggest that neighborhood networks play an important role in shaping intergenerational economic mobility.

35809.title: Terra Incognita: The Economics of a Shrinking World
35809.zh_title: 未知之地：一个萎缩世界的经济学
35809.zh_abstract_excerpt: 截至2026年，人类很可能已低于更替生育率。这在以前从未发生过，无论战争还是大流行病时期都没有。但真正令人意外的是，下降集中在低收入和中等收入国家，以及较贫穷和受教育程度较低的女性中。我们对1950年以来236个国家拟合了一个单因子模型：共同成分在1978年达到峰值，而今天推动生育率下降的是国家特定趋势，其中219个为负，且没有一个趋于平稳。
35809.abstract: As of 2026, humanity is likely below replacement fertility. That has never happened before, not in wars or pandemics. But the real surprise is that the fall has been concentrated in low- and middle-income countries and among poorer and less educated women. We fit a single-factor model to 236 countries since 1950: the common component peaked in 1978, and what drives fertility down today are country-specific trends, 219 of them negative and not one leveling off. None of the commonly cited mechanisms can account for this pattern, so we offer a conjecture: modernity itself, which makes a third child expensive and childlessness cheap. Children come in integers, so it takes very little to move a cohort’s fertility rate from 1.8 to 1.3. And nothing in an economy pushes fertility back to 2.1. We close with the main economic consequences, in particular slow growth.

35808.title: Shipping to America
35808.authors: Xiwen Bai, Jesús Fernández-Villaverde, Yiliang Li, Ricardo Marto, Francesco Zanetti
35808.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们研究美国方向航运路线中断的宏观经济与贸易政策含义。标准模型将其视为冰山成本冲击，从而将冲击与对冲击的反应混为一谈。利用卫星船舶追踪数据，我们构建了2016年至2025年所有美国方向集装箱船的路线层面潜在运力与有效运力指标。近期中断中的利用率损失达到20至40个百分点，并且在港口拥堵变得可见之前数月就已开始。
35808.abstract: We study the macroeconomic and trade-policy implications of disruptions to U.S.-bound shipping routes. Standard models treat them as iceberg-cost shocks, conflating the shock with the response to it. Using satellite vessel-tracking data, we construct route-level measures of potential and effective capacity for all U.S.-bound container ships from 2016 to 2025. Utilization losses in recent disruptions ran 20 to 40 percentage points, and began months before port congestion became visible. We embed these measures in a general equilibrium model in which firms reallocate a common fleet without internalizing the congestion they create and price above marginal cost, while importers' sourcing responds to route profitability. The reallocation triggered by a disruption then has first-order welfare effects, and the route's Domar weight is not a sufficient statistic for its welfare cost. The 2021 West Coast crisis and the 2023-2024 Red Sea attacks cost 0.69% and 0.35% of output. Naval protection of Red Sea shipping generated benefits of 0.04-0.08% of output at a fiscal cost of 0.02%. Tariffs decongest the routes they tax, offsetting or even reversing their conventional welfare cost.

35807.title: Network General Equilibrium as a Threat to Identification: The Failure of Time Fixed Effects
35807.zh_title: 网络一般均衡对识别的威胁：时间固定效应的失败
35807.zh_abstract_excerpt: 时间固定效应不是一般均衡控制。在网络经济中，总体冲击不会均匀地进入企业结果：它们通过均衡价格、成本和需求传播，在时间去均值后留下残余的网络梯度。当工具、处理或暴露设计即使部分地与这一梯度对齐时，标准面板估计量所恢复的是直接效应加上内生的网络泄漏成分。我们开发了一个易于处理的框架，以闭式形式刻画并量化这种Network-SUTVA偏误，并展示网络拓扑如何决定其大小。弱工具会放大泄漏。
35807.abstract: Time fixed effects are not a general-equilibrium control. In network economies, aggregate shocks do not enter firm outcomes uniformly: they propagate through equilibrium prices, costs, and demand, leaving a residual network gradient after time demeaning. When an instrument, treatment, or exposure design even partially aligns with this gradient, standard panel estimators recover the direct effect plus an endogenous network-leakage component. We develop a tractable framework that signs and quantifies this Network-SUTVA bias in closed form, showing how network topology governs its magnitude. Weak instruments magnify the leakage. Difference-in-differences designs are similarly contaminated because controls can be untreated by assignment but treated in equilibrium. Calibrated to the U.S. production network, the distortion can exceed 130% of the true direct effect. We propose observed- and hidden-network diagnostics and remedies, and test them on canonical difference-in-differences designs, showing that standard estimators can confound direct policy responses with systemic network leakage.

35806.title: Deep Learning as a Projection Method for Solving Economic Models
35806.zh_title: 深度学习作为求解经济模型的投影方法
35806.zh_abstract_excerpt: 在经济学中，深度学习日益被呈现为求解动态模型的新范式，取代了数值经济学的经典投影方法。我们认为，这种二分法建立在错误分类之上。这一文献所强调的神经网络求解器，是具有自适应非线性参数化的最小二乘投影方法。将深度学习置于投影方法族之内会重新调整研究议程。问题不在于范式之间的竞赛，而是提示我们使用单一工具箱，根据手头模型择优选择各种近似方法、残差准则和评估设计。
35806.abstract: Deep learning is increasingly presented in economics as a new paradigm for solving dynamic models, superseding the classical projection methods of numerical economics. We argue that this dichotomy rests on a misclassification. The neural-network solvers emphasized in this literature are least-squares projection methods with an adaptive nonlinear parameterization. Placing deep learning inside the projection family reorients the agenda. The issue is not a contest between paradigms, but suggests a single toolkit using a variety of approximation methods, residual criteria, and evaluation designs to be chosen on the merits for the model at hand. In low and moderate dimensions, linear-basis and sparsegrid methods are often more accurate, faster, and easier to verify than a trained neural network. In high dimensions, an appropriate choice for the space of permissible functions will often avoid the curse of dimensionality.

35805.title: Foreign Tax Advantages after the U.S. Tax Reform of 2017
35805.zh_title: 2017年美国税改后的外国税收优势
35805.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们利用上市公司年度10-K申报中的所得税税率调节表构建了一个企业-年度面板，以研究《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）对美国跨国公司利润转移的影响。这些调节表分解了公司层面有效税率与联邦法定公司税率之间的差距，使我们能够分离改革前后外国税收优势的贡献。我们发现，TCJA显著缩小了税率差距，并提高了那些在TCJA前最受国际税收优惠影响公司的有效税率。这导致了利润回流，外国利润份额每对应税率上升1个百分点便下降1.3个百分点。
35805.abstract: We construct a firm-year panel of income-tax rate reconciliations from annual 10-K filings of public companies to study the effects of the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) on U.S. multinational profit shifting. These reconciliations decompose the gap between company-level effective tax rates and the federal statutory corporate tax rate, allowing us to isolate the contribution of foreign tax advantages before and after the reform. We find that TCJA significantly reduced the tax rate gap and increased effective tax rates for companies most exposed to pre-TCJA international tax benefits. This resulted in an onshoring of profits with foreign profit shares falling 1.3 percentage points per percentage point of tax increase. Among more exposed companies, we find no differential change in investment, employment, or the geographic distribution of sales and installed capital. A neoclassical model of a multinational that chooses where to book its income rationalizes this pattern: the reform raised the average tax on income booked abroad relative to income booked at home, which governs where profits are reported, while the marginal tax on capital, which governs investment, changed by an amount common to all firms. Controlling for deferred-tax windfall gains leaves our main results unchanged.

35804.title: Beveridgean Phillips Curve
35804.zh_title: 贝弗里奇式菲利普斯曲线
35804.zh_abstract_excerpt: 本文发展了一个贝弗里奇式菲利普斯曲线模型。新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线基于价格调整成本下的垄断定价，而贝弗里奇式菲利普斯曲线基于价格调整成本下的定向搜寻定价。在定向搜寻下，价格对松弛程度而非边际成本作出反应。由此得到的菲利普斯曲线具有三个与近期美国证据相符的性质。第一，它实现了神圣巧合：只要失业处于其有效水平——充分就业失业率（FERU），即失业率与职位空缺率的几何平均值——通胀就处于目标水平。
35804.abstract: This paper develops a Beveridgean model of the Phillips curve. While the New Keynesian Phillips curve is based on monopolistic pricing under price-adjustment costs, the Beveridgean Phillips curve is based on directed-search pricing under price-adjustment costs. Under directed search, prices respond to slack instead of marginal costs. The resulting Phillips curve has three properties that match recent US evidence. First, it delivers the divine coincidence: inflation is on target whenever unemployment is at its efficient level—the full-employment rate of unemployment (FERU), the geometric mean of the unemployment and vacancy rates. Second, it is decreasing and convex in the unemployment-inflation plane: inflation responds more strongly to unemployment when the labor market is inefficiently tight than when it is inefficiently slack. The convexity is inherited from the Beveridge curve, which makes unemployment a decreasing and convex function of tightness. Third, shifts of the Beveridge curve move the FERU and therefore shift the unemployment-inflation Phillips curve. The model also implies that the Fed's dual mandate is internally consistent, that a soft landing from an inefficiently tight labor market is possible, and that the zero lower bound is not topsy-turvy.

35803.title: Injury, Workload, and the Strategic Response of Coaches in the NBA
35803.zh_title: NBA中的伤病、工作量与教练的战略反应
35803.authors: Kala Krishna, Sergey Lychagin, Lewis S. McLean
35803.zh_abstract_excerpt: 工人努力会增加当期产出，但可能导致伤病或倦怠。将努力从最容易受伤的工人身上转移开本可降低这一风险，但关于暴露程度的信息往往是隐藏的。我们研究管理者是否会依据此类私人信息采取行动，并将NBA作为一个数据丰富的工作场所。以队友缺阵作为工作量的工具变量，我们发现工作会因果性地提高受伤风险，这与运动医学研究中常见的虚假负相关形成对比。我们还表明，教练会针对伤病风险冲击让球员休息。通过依据这种私人信息采取行动，教练可以提高球员生产率。
35803.abstract: Worker effort increases contemporaneous output but may result in injury or burnout. Directing effort away from the workers most exposed to injury would reduce this risk, but information on the exposure is often hidden. We ask whether managers act on such private information, studying the NBA as a data-rich workplace. Instrumenting workload with teammate absence, we find that work causally raises injury risk, which contrasts with the spurious negative correlation commonly found in sports medicine studies. We also show that coaches rest players in response to injury risk shocks. By acting on this private information, coaches can raise player productivity.

35802.title: The Political Foundations of Industrial Policy: Emergence, Endurance, and Exhaustion
35802.zh_title: 产业政策的政治基础：兴起、延续与耗尽
35802.authors: Lottie Field, Réka Juhász, Michele Zampa
35802.zh_abstract_excerpt: 我们通过20世纪两个典型案例研究政治如何塑造产业政策：意大利的南方基金（1950—1984年）和美国的肯尼迪登月计划（1961—1972年）。基于历史资料和原始政治文献，我们表明，每项政策都源于更广泛的政治工程，而非经济诊断：基督教民主党追求国家整合与民主巩固，以及肯尼迪的“新边疆”。
35802.abstract: We study how politics shapes industrial policy through two paradigmatic twentieth-century cases: the Cassa per il Mezzogiorno in Italy (1950–1984) and Kennedy's Moonshot in the United States (1961–1972). Drawing on historical and primary political sources, we show that each policy originated in a broader political project rather than in an economic diagnosis: the Christian Democrats' pursuit of national integration and democratic consolidation, and Kennedy's New Frontier. We introduce the concept of industrial policy vision - a publicly articulated, transformational objective that political leaders attach to a set of ideals and pursue through state-led intervention in the economy - and develop a five-component definition that makes it empirically tractable. We then trace each vision through decades of newspaper coverage, combining topic modeling and sentiment analysis with systematic close reading. In both cases, public debate proceeded largely within the frame the vision set, granting the policies tolerance for setbacks and expense. The cases diverge in their fates: the Moonshot's bounded vision was redeemed on schedule, while the Cassa's open-ended vision was exhausted by accumulated failure and the policy outlived it only briefly. This divergence points to our central conclusion: while a vision holds, it sets the terms on which an industrial policy's performance is judged, including what counts as failure and how much time the policy is given to deliver.
